description: Pick which of YOUR connected tools a task needs, so you load a handful of definitions instead of all of them. Pass the task and the tool definitions you have (from tools/list across your servers); get back the minimal set ranked by fit, with the tokens saved. Hybrid semantic + keyword retrieval with operation-aware reranking. Nothing you send is stored.

maxTokens.description: Optional budget for the selected definitions.

task.description: What you are about to do, in plain language.

tools.description: Your available tool definitions (name, description, inputSchema…).

name: select_tools
